body:
Just tried nghttp and this is what I'm seeing in the netty example server:

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: name
    at io.netty.channel.AbstractChannelHandlerContext.<init>(AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java:80)
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.<init>(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:26)
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelPipeline.newContext(DefaultChannelPipeline.java:111)
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelPipeline.addAfter(DefaultChannelPipeline.java:312)
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelPipeline.addAfter(DefaultChannelPipeline.java:297)
    at io.netty.handler.codec.http2.Http2ServerUpgradeCodec.upgradeTo(Http2ServerUpgradeCodec.java:136)
    at io.netty.handler.codec.http.HttpServerUpgradeHandler$1.operationComplete(HttpServerUpgradeHandler.java:325)
    at io.netty.handler.codec.http.HttpServerUpgradeHandler$1.operationComplete(HttpServerUpgradeHandler.java:318)
```

It seems that something may have broken WRT allowing null names.

@normanmaurer Any ideas?
